name: Clean corners restore original pixels and dither fills coarse pointer paths
description: Exact pixel/history/reload checks for whole-stroke corner filtering and interpolated canvas-anchored dither.

planSteps.description: Use a fresh isolated desktop browser context with 1280x720 or wider viewport. Open Studio and wait for restoration. Write a runner-local corner.pixibun file containing exactly this synthetic original JSON and import through the file picker/Confirm Import. Report unsupported upload as BLOCKED. JSON: {"format":"pixibun-project","version":3,"name":"Corner fixture","width":32,"height":32,"fps":8,"loopMode":"repeat","onionSkin":{"enabled":false,"prevFrames":1,"nextFrames":1,"prevColor":"#c792df","nextColor":"#dcabdf","opacity":0.45},"palettes":[{"id":"colors","name":"Colors","colors":["#ff0000","#00ff00"]}],"currentPaletteId":"colors","customRamps":[],"clips":[],"frames":[{"id":"frame","durationMs":100,"layers":[{"id":"body","name":"Body","visible":true,"locked":false,"opacity":1,"blendMode":"source-over","pngBase64":"iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACAAAAAgCAYAAABzenr0AAAAIklEQVR4nO3OMQEAAAgDoEW3ub4m0AcSkLB16rsAAAAA5waZWgGAKBwERAAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="}]}],"createdAt":1,"updatedAt":1}
Select Pen, size 1, Clean corners enabled. Drag one stroke through pixel centers (2,2), (3,2), (3,3), sending a separate pointer movement for each coordinate, then release.

Download Export → Project Backup → Download project backup and decode the Body PNG. Use the supported download fallback if needed. Inspect actual downloaded metadata/pixels, not a private application store. Report unavailable file/pixel inspection as BLOCKED or INCONCLUSIVE, never a visibility-only pass.
Verify Body pixel (3,2) is exactly [0,255,0,128], restoring the original beneath the removed corner. Pixels (2,2) and (3,3) have alpha 255. Retain all decoded bytes as the drawn baseline.
Focus the drawing canvas and press Ctrl+Z. Download and decode another project backup.
Verify all original pixel bytes are restored: only (3,2) is [0,255,0,128], every other pixel is transparent.
Focus canvas, press Ctrl+Y, Save to browser storage, wait for Changes saved and reload. Download/decode the reopened backup.
Verify every decoded Body byte matches the drawn baseline, including the preserved green corner pixel.

Focus the canvas and press D to select Dither Brush without a hovering tool preview. Keep size 1, Bayer 2x2 and density 0.5. Drag from (0,8) directly to (20,8), with one movement between endpoints, then release. Download/decode the backup and retain these bytes.
Verify alpha 255 at x=0,2,...,20 along y=8 and alpha 0 at x=1,3,...,19. Earlier Pen pixels remain unchanged.
Focus canvas and Undo the dither. Draw the same Dither stroke with a movement through every integer x from 0 to 20 at y=8. Download and decode the backup.
Verify all decoded bytes match the coarse dither baseline. Missing intermediate pattern pixels must fail the test.
Undo, Redo, Save, wait for Changes saved and reload. Download/decode the backup.
Verify exact reopened Body bytes still match the dither baseline. Report missing history/reload assertions explicitly.
